summary_md: **lin ruibiao ([@LRuibiao69297](https://x.com/LRuibiao69297/status/2116168099011678384))** notes Liquid AI's **LFM3** family: six ~2B open-weight models sharing one backbone for text, vision, audio and omni; the text model is about 1 GB at 4-bit with 256K context and fine-tunable on one GPU ([LiquidAI LFM3 collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/LiquidAI/lfm3)).
relevance: Small multimodal local models for agents.
